name: What should I do first to make my website visible to AI search engines?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first to make my website visible to AI search engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by ensuring your critical content is in plain HTML, not hidden behind JavaScript or logins, and update your robots.txt to allow AI crawlers. These technical fixes are the foundation; without them, AI models cannot read or cite your site regardless of how good your content is.
acceptedAnswer.description: Put critical content in plain HTML, remove JavaScript barriers, and allow AI crawlers in robots.txt.
